name: Field Dressing
description: Restore 1 HP to yourself or a survivor.

name: Self Attack
description: Hurt yourself. Removes 1 HP from your own health.

name: Attack Survivor
targetDescription: You were attacked! You lose 1 HP.

name: Attack All
description: Attack all survivors. Each loses 1 HP.
targetDescription: You were caught in an attack! You lose 1 HP.

name: Stay Still
description: Don't move for 30 seconds. Stand exactly where you are.
targetDescription: You are stunned! Don't move for 30 seconds.

name: Cry Out
description: Cry out your current location so everyone can hear you.

name: Room Order
description: Go to room 3 immediately and wait there.

name: Blast Radius
description: You were in the blast radius. Hurt yourself — remove 1 HP.
targetDescription: You were in the blast radius! Hurt yourself — remove 1 HP.

name: Stun Killer
description: Stun the killer for 15 seconds. They cannot move.
targetDescription: You are stunned! You cannot move for 15 seconds.

name: Disarm
description: The killer cannot attack for 30 seconds. Put your weapon down.
targetDescription: You are disarmed! You cannot attack for 30 seconds.
